audit_items.title: Does the Beacon Node (actor-beacon-node) correctly distinguish between deprecated protocol usage and malicious peer behavior when adjusting scores?

phase1_result.summary: Critical state-space anomaly found: RPC handler does not distinguish between deprecated protocol versions and malicious requests
phase1_result.key_anomaly: Protocol Version State Confusion - Handler validates all protocol versions (Deneb/Electra/Fulu V1) using only current epoch rules

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the ENR eth2 field validated to be exactly 16 bytes before SSZ deserialization?

phase1_result.summary: ENR eth2 field validation exists in forkEntry() function with 16-byte buffer allocation
phase1_result.key_finding: Buffer over-read protection exists via fixed-size allocation

phase2_result.defense_mechanism: Fixed 16-byte buffer allocation in forkEntry() at fork.go:165

phase3_result.validation_confirmed: ENR eth2 field uses fixed 16-byte buffer, preventing over-read

audit_items.title: Can a malicious P2P peer cause buffer over-read or under-read by sending ENR eth2 fields with invalid lengths?

phase1_result.summary: SSZ UnmarshalSSZ implementation includes length validation
phase1_result.key_finding: ENRForkID.UnmarshalSSZ validates size exactly equals 16 bytes

phase3_result.validation_confirmed: ENRForkID.UnmarshalSSZ requires buf length == 16, returns error otherwise

audit_items.title: Does the beacon node properly reject peers with invalid ENR eth2 fields during discovery handshake?

phase1_result.summary: ENR validation in compareForkENR() rejects peers with invalid eth2 fields
phase1_result.key_finding: compareForkENR() calls forkEntry() which validates SSZ format

phase2_result.validation_flow: forkEntry() -> UnmarshalSSZ() -> error returned -> connection rejected

phase3_result.validation_confirmed: Invalid ENR eth2 fields cause forkEntry() to return error, preventing peer acceptance

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-009: Does BPO fork ENR eth2 field computation correctly preserve next_fork_version equal to current_fork_version?

phase1_result.summary: BPO fork handling logic found in updateENR() function
phase1_result.key_finding: updateENR() sets NextForkVersion from next.ForkVersion, but BPO-specific logic unclear

phase2_result.issue: BPO fork detection logic NOT explicitly implemented in updateENR()
phase2_result.gap: No code path that sets NextForkVersion = CurrentForkVersion for BPO forks

phase3_result.issue: BPO fork handling may not correctly preserve next_fork_version == current_fork_version invariant
phase3_result.recommended_action: Verify BPO fork detection and add explicit logic to preserve version equality

audit_items.title: Does the P2P peer actor correctly validate incoming ENR eth2 fields for BPO fork compatibility?

phase1_result.summary: ENR validation in compareForkENR() checks CurrentForkDigest and NextForkVersion
phase1_result.key_finding: NextForkVersion validation at fork.go:89-94, but no BPO-specific exception

phase2_result.issue: BPO fork peers may be incorrectly rejected due to NextForkVersion mismatch
phase2_result.gap: No BPO fork detection in compareForkENR() validation logic

phase3_result.issue: Validation logic may reject compatible BPO fork peers
phase3_result.recommended_action: Add BPO fork detection and allow NextForkVersion == CurrentForkVersion for BPO

audit_items.title: Does the beacon node correctly compute and advertise ENR eth2 field for BPO forks?

phase1_result.summary: ENR advertisement logic in updateENR() sets NextForkVersion from params
phase1_result.key_finding: updateENR() at fork.go:130-160, no BPO-specific version preservation

phase2_result.issue: BPO fork advertisement may not preserve NextForkVersion == CurrentForkVersion
phase2_result.impact: Network fragmentation if BPO fork ENR advertised incorrectly

phase3_result.issue: Beacon node may advertise incorrect ENR for BPO forks
phase3_result.recommended_action: Implement BPO fork detection and version preservation logic

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-009: Is the ENR eth2 field correctly signaling no upcoming fork by setting next_fork_version == current_fork_version AND next_fork_epoch == FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH?

phase1_result.summary: No-fork signaling logic found in updateENR() at line 136-138
phase1_result.key_finding: Correct implementation: when entry.Epoch == next.Epoch, sets NextForkEpoch = FarFutureEpoch

phase2_result.validation_confirmed: NextForkEpoch set to FarFutureEpoch when no fork scheduled

phase3_result.validation_confirmed: No-fork state correctly signals NextForkEpoch = FarFutureEpoch

audit_items.title: Does the beacon node (actor-beacon-node) correctly compute ENR eth2 fields for peer discovery when transitioning between fork states?

phase1_result.summary: ENR update during fork transitions handled by updateENR() function
phase1_result.key_finding: updateENR() called with entry and next params from network schedule

phase2_result.validation_confirmed: Fork transition logic correctly updates ENR fields based on schedule
phase2_result.note: Assumes NetworkScheduleEntry correctly populated by config

phase3_result.assumption: NetworkScheduleEntry correctness depends on config/params package
phase3_result.validation_confirmed: ENR updates correctly during fork transitions given correct schedule data

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for tb-009: Does the ENR eth2 field computation use wall-clock time instead of sync state for epoch determination?

phase1_result.summary: ENR fork digest computation uses wall-clock via currentForkDigest()
phase1_result.key_finding: currentForkDigest() at fork.go:30-39 uses slots.CurrentSlot(s.genesisTime) which is wall-clock based

phase2_result.validation_confirmed: Fork digest uses wall-clock time, not sync state

phase3_result.validation_confirmed: ENR eth2 field correctly uses wall-clock time for epoch determination
